community_list_entries.name: What Does It Mean to Forget a Person? Individual-Level Unlearning in Vision-Language Models

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Introduces a benchmark for individual-level multimodal unlearning in VLMs: 60 synthetic individuals are injected into VLMs by LoRA fine-tuning, then unlearned, and evaluated on 4,860 probes in four task families (attribute access, identity access, binding, reconstruction).
